# Third-party notices

No third-party code is bundled in this artifact.

This package ships hand-written source rather than a bundler artifact, so this file is
maintained by hand instead of being generated from a module graph. Its declared dependency
(`@opencode-ai/plugin`) is resolved by the package manager at install time and is not copied
into the published files. If a future change inlines third-party code into any file listed in
`files`, replace this notice with the corresponding license texts — the change will be visible
in review, because the shipped files are committed source rather than build output.
